paper_title: Aerobic oxidation of indole carbinols using Fe(NO3)3·9H2O/TEMPO/NaCl as catalysts†

questions.question: In the paper, what does the abbreviation 'Ts' (as used in labels such as 1a) refer to?
What is the chemical name/structure given in the paper for compound 2a?
According to the standard reaction conditions used for the aerobic oxidation of 1a to 2a (Table 1), which solvent and oxidant/atmosphere were used?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Solvent: DCE (1,2‑dichloroethane); oxidant/atmosphere: oxygen (O2) delivered from an O2 balloon (room temperature)

questions.question: Which gave the higher isolated yield of 2a: the reaction of 1a under the standard O2 conditions shown in Table 1 entry 1, or the reaction of 1a using air in DCE summarized in Table 4 entry 1?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Table 1 entry 1 (standard O2 conditions) gave 99% yield, which is higher than the air/DCE reaction in Table 4 entry 1 (97%).
